newsitem.title: GERMANY: Striking German NATO workers protest in Bonn.
newsitem.headline: Striking German NATO workers protest in Bonn.

text.p: Seven thousand civilian workers from United States and British NATO bases in Germany demonstrated in Bonn on Wednesday against cost-cutting measures planned by their employers, unions said.

The one-hour protest through streets in central Bonn followed the restart of strike action by some 4,000 workers on Tuesday after negotiations between unions and employer representatives collapsed last week.

Around 35,000 civilians, mostly German, are employed by NATO allies across the country. Many civilians working at the bases have already lost their jobs as NATO forces in Germany have been cut back since the end of the Cold War.

Walter Kolbow, defence policy spokesman for the opposition Social Democratic Party (SPD), said Chancellor Helmut Kohl's ruling coalition had repeatedly blocked efforts by it to secure compensation measures for civilians who had lost their jobs as a result of the cutbacks.
Kolbow called on the government to recognise its "social responsibility" for the staff affected.
